records.narration: This VizieR metadata census asks which single tables intersect the abundance-search, mass-search, and redshift-search axes.
on_screen_copy_leaf_strings: Which VizieR single tables have metadata-reachable columns on the abundance-search, mass-search, and redshift-search axes?
METADATA CENSUS — NOT AN MZR MEASUREMENT
SINGLE-TABLE METADATA INTERSECTION · CROSS-TABLE JOINS AND CROSSMATCHES NOT ASSESSED

records.narration: The search combined semantic UCD tags with column-name variants, and each frozen query returned exactly its pre-counted rows.
records.display_citation: IVOA UCD1+ v1.5; NebulaMind VizieR census, 2026-08-05

records.narration: UCD plus name matching reached 5,568 tables on the abundance-search axis, 6,206 on mass-search, and 6,687 on redshift-search; name matching added 175, 88, and 20.
on_screen_copy_leaf_strings: ABUNDANCE SEARCH · UCD 5,393 · UCD + NAME 5,568 · GAIN +175 TABLES
MASS SEARCH · UCD 6,118 · UCD + NAME 6,206 · GAIN +88 TABLES
REDSHIFT SEARCH · UCD 6,667 · UCD + NAME 6,687 · GAIN +20 TABLES

records.narration: The three axis lists intersected at 178 candidate tables.
on_screen_copy_leaf_strings: RECORDED METADATA CANDIDATES · NOT ELIGIBILITY RULINGS

records.narration: Modifier columns then emptied a required search axis in 21 tables: 19 on redshift-search and 2 on abundance-search, leaving 157 recorded candidates.
on_screen_copy_leaf_strings: 2 · ABUNDANCE-SEARCH AXIS EMPTIED · e_Ha/Hb · e_logOI/Ha · l_logOI/Ha

records.narration: As a side check, a frozen term regex matched 62 of those 157 recorded descriptions; it is not an eligibility filter, and T2 still applies to all 157.
on_screen_copy_leaf_strings: FROZEN VOCABULARY REGEX PRESENCE · NOT ADJUDICATED GAS-PHASE EVIDENCE
SIDE CHECK ONLY · NOT AN ELIGIBILITY FILTER · T2 STILL APPLIES TO ALL 157

records.narration: All seven pinned recall members returned, while none of the three controls appeared.
Those checks validate retrieval, not precision: the frozen controls did not cover the source-redshift qualifier contamination documented in the manifest.
on_screen_copy_leaf_strings: FROZEN CONTROLS DID NOT COVER THE RECORDED src.redshift-QUALIFIER CONTAMINATION

records.narration: Recorded examples separate symbol-and-meaning collisions—Galactic height and model-grid metal fraction—from target-domain mismatches: stellar gravitational redshift and gravitational-redshift velocity. They are not T2 rulings.
on_screen_copy_leaf_strings: T1 RECORDED CHARACTERIZATION · NOT T2 RULINGS

records.narration: The T2 rule contract was frozen after seven gate rounds over twelve decoys and three anchors, but the 157-table eligibility application is not completed, so no eligible-table count or metallicity measurement is reportable yet.
